rationale: Canada-EU associate membership continues; UN war crimes finding on US-Iran strikes is distant; EU social media age restriction is regulatory proposal; no new regional security developments affecting Romania.

top_events.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
top_events.label: UN cites possible US war crimes Iran
top_events.summary: UN experts found grounds to believe US committed war crimes in February strikes on Iranian civilians. Distant Middle East conflict with no direct impact on Romanian daily life.

top_events.title: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for under-15s
top_events.label: EU proposes social media age limit fifteen
top_events.summary: EU announced plans to restrict social media accounts to users over 15. Regulatory proposal with no immediate enforcement; affects Romanian families indirectly.

top_events.title: Canada welcomes EU proposal to become 'associate member'
top_events.label: Canada welcomes EU associate membership proposal
top_events.summary: Canadian PM Carney welcomed the EU proposal for closer ties. Continuation of existing diplomatic initiative with no immediate economic impact on Romania.

short_summary: US Fed hikes rates despite Trump pressure

most_significant_event.label: US Fed hikes rates despite Trump pressure
most_significant_event.summary: Federal Reserve raised rates unanimously against Trump's wishes. This tightens global credit, raising costs for Romanian government and businesses dependent on EU financial markets.
